name: Realistic (Doers)
description: Hands-on, practical, athletic, mechanical. Enjoys working with tools, machines, plants, animals, or building things.

name: Investigative (Thinkers)
description: Analytical, intellectual, scientific, exploratory. Enjoys solving abstract problems, math, science, and research.

name: Artistic (Creators)
description: Creative, original, independent, expressive. Enjoys art, drama, crafts, dance, music, and creative writing.

name: Social (Helpers)
description: Cooperative, supporting, healing, enlightening. Enjoys teaching, counseling, nursing, or giving service.

name: Enterprising (Persuaders)
description: Competitive, persuasive, leadership-oriented. Enjoys starting up and carrying out projects, leading people, and making decisions.

name: Conventional (Organizers)
description: Detail-oriented, organized, clerical. Enjoys working with numbers, records, or machines in a set, logical order.
